jobs.title: Technical Program Manager - Business Risk
jobs.description:
At Audible, we believe stories have the power to transform lives. It’s why we work with some of the world’s leading creators to produce and share audio storytelling with our millions of global listeners. We are dreamers and inventors who come from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences to empower and inspire each other. Imagine your future with us.  
  
ABOUT THIS ROLE  
As a Senior Technical Program Manager focused on Business Risk, you'll serve as the strategic risk advisor to one of Audible's business organizations, partnering with its senior leaders to understand and manage the risks they face across security, fraud, content piracy, data protection, brand, and operational domains. Audible's businesses depend on a broad network of external partners, vendors, platforms, and technology, and increasingly on AI-enabled operations. Each relationship and each system is a place where unauthorized access, fraud, data exposure, or operational failure can become financial loss or harm to the Audible brand.  
  
You will own Audible's business risk program for the organization you support end to end. You'll assess its business processes, vendor and partner relationships, and technology stack; drive remediation programs to completion with Audible InfoSec, Amazon Security, and business teams; run the recurring risk review and risk acceptance process; and own risk reporting to business and Audible leadership. Rather than building new programs, you'll use Audible's and Amazon's established risk management programs and paved path solutions, including security, fraud defense, piracy prevention, and data protection, and help the business adopt them in a way that fits how it works. Your understanding of the organization's strategy and roadmap will let you position risk management as an enabler, so the business can scale, enter new markets, and launch new initiatives safely.  
  
ABOUT YOU  
You thrive at the intersection of risk advisory and business enablement. You see risk not as a blocker but as a lens that helps a business grow safely and move faster. You are comfortable starting where the problem is not yet defined: you can take an open question such as "how exposed are we, and where?", frame the program, set its goals and success metrics, and drive it to delivery with limited guidance. You build trusted relationships with senior business leaders, translate technical risk into business language, and influence teams that do not report to you, including security, engineering, legal, and external partners. You make thoughtful trade-offs between short-term needs and long-term risk reduction, and you know how and when to escalate without damaging relationships. Your security background lets you speak credibly with security teams and understand the technical detail behind a risk. You write clear, concise narratives and are comfortable presenting risk decisions to Directors and VPs. You are a simplifier: you add process only where it earns its place, and you retire it when it no longer does.  
  
As a Senior Technical Program Manager - Business Risk, you will...  

* Serve as the primary business risk advisor to the senior leadership of the Audible business organization you support, building trusted relationships and helping leaders understand risks across security, fraud, content piracy, data protection, brand, and operational domains
* Own the business risk program for that organization end to end: define its scope, goals, and success metrics, and drive it from assessment through remediation with limited guidance
* Conduct risk assessments of the organization's business processes, platforms, technology stack, and vendor and partner relationships, and turn findings into prioritized, measurable remediation plans
* Drive governance and hardening programs for the external platforms, accounts, and third-party access the business depends on, in partnership with security and platform owners
* Assess risks in AI-enabled and automated business processes, including AI vendor solutions and the data that flows through them
* Run the recurring risk review and the risk acceptance and policy exception process for the organization, ensuring risk decisions are made at the right level, documented, and revisited
* Embed risk review into the organization's planning and launch processes, so new vendors, platforms, products, and markets are assessed before they go live rather than after an incident
* Partner with Audible InfoSec, Amazon Security, Fraud Defense, Anti-Piracy, Legal, Privacy, and Compliance to bring expert guidance and established paved path solutions to the business, and drive their adoption rather than building new programs
* Own risk reporting for the organization, developing risk metrics, dashboards, and executive narratives that give leadership clear visibility into risk posture and remediation progress
* Present risk information to Directors and VPs, laying out the options, the trade-offs between short-term needs and long-term risk reduction, and the decision required
* Negotiate priorities and resources across business, security, and engineering teams to deliver remediation on schedule, and escalate effectively when a path forward is blocked
* Proactively identify emerging risks from changes in the organization's business model, vendors, technology, and use of AI, and streamline or retire risk processes that no longer add value
* Contribute to Audible's broader business risk program, including the shared risk assessment framework, risk acceptance governance, and leadership reporting across business risk areas
* Mentor and develop others, and contribute to hiring for the business risk team

  
ABOUT AUDIBLE  
Audible is the leading producer and provider of audio storytelling. We spark listeners’ imaginations, offering immersive, cinematic experiences full of inspiration and insight to enrich our customers daily lives. We are a global company with an entrepreneurial spirit. We are dreamers and invento

jobs.title: Associate Program Manager AI Transformation & Delivery
jobs.description:
Overview:

BRMi is seeking an Associate Program Manager to support a large financial enterprise client in either Vienna, VA or Pensacola, FL.

**This role provides project management capacity for AI, technology, and process improvement work across Marketing. The primary focus is coordinating AI initiatives from intake and proof of concept through build, testing, deployment, adoption, scaling, and transition to support.**

**The role is not an AI engineering position.** The Associate Program Manager will partner with business leads, delivery team leads, engineers, analysts, AI engineering teams, governance partners, and vendors to keep multiple initiatives moving, documented, governed, and on schedule. The role will flex between AI build-and-deploy work and activation of new AI use cases, proofs of concept, and AI enablement.

Apply sound project management, responsible AI, ITSM, and continuous improvement practices so that delivered solutions, including AI agents and models, Copilot and Copilot Studio agents, automation, and SharePoint tools, remain stable, governed, and supportable after launch.

**HYBRID in either Vienna,VA or Pensacola, FL 3 days per week onsite.**

Benefits:  

* Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* Employer-Paid Life Insurance
* Employer-Paid Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance
* 401(k)
* Paid Time Off (PTO) that includes Vacation Leave, Sick Leave, and 11 Paid Holidays
* Educational Assistance

Salary:

Vienna, VA- $116-119K (1-5 years experience)

Pensacola, FL: $99-102K (1-5 years experience)

$116-119K (5-10 years experience)

**\*\*An In Person interview will be required for this role\*\***

### **Intake & Planning**

* Run intake and triage for AI and process requests (for example, new AI use cases, Copilot and Copilot Studio agents, automation, SharePoint and process improvement requests), confirming business value, scope, level of effort and priority with business and team leads

* Use Azure DevOps (ADO) to plan, track and report on epics, features, backlog items and releases, keeping boards current and traceable to business requests.

* Identify process gaps and recurring issues, partner with analysts to recommend and implement non-AI and AI-assisted improvements, and model effective use of AI tools such as Microsoft 365 Copilot in day-to-day project work

### **Essential**

* Azure DevOps (ADO) or comparable agile work-management tool experience (for example Jira)

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
Northramp is seeking a motivated Business Analyst to support a technology program for a federal client. The role sits between the client’s business stakeholders and the technical team, making sure business needs are captured accurately and communicated clearly to the technology teams who build the solution, and governed through project oversight and vendor delivery.

You will work alongside client stakeholders and technical team members to gather and document requirements, maintain project artifacts, and support Agile delivery activities. You will turn business needs into user stories and acceptance criteria, document processes and system functionality, and help the team spot gaps, risks, and opportunities to improve the user experience, as well as ensure that the agency's vendors are delivering as required.

This role is part of Northramp’s integrated delivery model, where engineers and advisors work as one team to bring sound judgment, disciplined execution, and deep federal experience to high-stakes modernization programs.

**Location & Work Arrangement**

Hybrid, based in the Washington, DC metro area. On-site presence at client locations in Washington, DC is expected on a cadence aligned to program needs, including knowledge-transfer workshops and stakeholder sessions. This role is not open to candidates outside the DC region.

**The Ideal Candidate**

You are organized, analytical, and curious, and you work comfortably where business operations and technology meet. You have 7+ years of experience in business analysis, technology consulting, or project coordination, and you write and speak clearly with both business and technical audiences. You keep project information organized so the team can find what it needs, you manage multiple priorities without losing track of the details, and you build good working relationships with clients and developers alike. You also know how to help people adopt new systems and ways of working. You are Prosci-certified, you can assess how a change will affect different user groups, and you plan the communications, training, and readiness activities that get them ready for it. Familiarity with Agile delivery and tools such as Jira and Confluence is a plus.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Manage requirements:** support the gathering, documentation, and management of business and system requirements.
* **Translate business needs:** work with stakeholders and technical team members to turn business needs into user stories, acceptance criteria, and other project documentation.
* **Document processes:** help document business processes, workflows, system functionality, and standard operating procedures.
* **Maintain the backlog:** keep user stories, tasks, and project information organized in client systems.
* **Delivery governance:** participate in governance activities and processes, seeing the requirements through to delivery and ensuring other technology vendors are delivering on contractual and reporting requirements.
* **Support testing and release:** document expected outcomes, track issues, and coordinate feedback during testing and release activities.
* **Prepare client materials:** produce meeting notes, presentations, status updates, and other client-facing materials.
* **Identify improvements:** flag requirements gaps, process issues, risks, and opportunities to improve the user experience.
* **Assess change impact:** conduct stakeholder analysis and change impact assessments to identify which user groups are affected by new systems and processes, and how.
* **Plan and execute change management:** apply Prosci methodology to develop change management, communications, and training plans that prepare users for new systems and processes.
* **Drive adoption:** measure user readiness and adoption, identify sources of resistance, and work with client leaders on actions that keep the change on track.
* **Build relationships:** develop positive working relationships with client stakeholders and members of the development team.

 **Requirements**

**Required Qualifications**

* 7+ years of experience in business analysis, technology consulting, project coordination, or a related field.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively as part of a team.
* Experience with Microsoft Office or similar productivity tools.
* Prosci OCM certification.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience.
* U.S. citizenship and ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Experience supporting technology or software development projects.
* Familiarity with Agile project management practices.
* Experience with Jira, Confluence, or similar collaboration tools.
* Experience working with federal government clients or programs.
* Basic understanding of web applications, databases, data analysis, or cloud technologies.

**Clearance**

U.S. citizenship and eligibility to work in the United States are required.

 **Benefits**  

* Employee Bonus Programs
* Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* 401(k) Retirement Plan
* Basic Life, Voluntary Life, and AD&D Insurance
* Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance
* Paid Time Off
* Paid Parental Leave
* Training and Professional Development
* Remote Work Opportunities
* Wellness Resources

jobs.title: Senior Cybersecurity Risk Program Manager, Ops Supply Chain
jobs.description:
NVIDIA has been redefining computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s motivated by great technology and amazing people. Today, we’re harnessing the boundless possibilities of AI to build the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Pioneering what has never existed calls for insight, inventiveness, and the world’s leading talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be part of a diverse, encouraging environment where everyone is motivated to perform at their highest level. Join us and discover how you can build a lasting impact on the world.

  

NVIDIA is seeking a Senior Cybersecurity Risk Program Manager, Ops Supply Chain to join our Operations team in Santa Clara, CA. In this senior individual-contributor role, you will lead and develop NVIDIA’s supplier and supply chain cybersecurity risk program. You will continuously coordinate efforts to identify, assess, and mitigate cyber risk. Your work will protect NVIDIA intellectual property and critical invention data across our global network of suppliers, contract manufacturers, and logistics partners. If you’re forward-thinking, driven, and excited to protect one of the world’s most critical technology supply chains, this role is for you!

  

**What you’ll be doing:**

* Own and mature NVIDIA’s supply chain cybersecurity risk program, leading the assessment and mitigation of cyber risk across suppliers, contract manufacturers, and logistics and distribution partners.
* Build and improve supplier risk assessment frameworks, policies, and procedures aligned to NIST (CSF 2.0 and SP 800-161 Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management) and ISO (27001 and 28000) standards.
* Safeguard NVIDIA intellectual property and confidential technical data across the supplier ecosystem, defining controls for secure data exchange, need-to-know access, retention and destruction, and supervising supplier adherence to contractual security and confidentiality obligations.
* Support the supply chain CTPAT and counterfeit program, encompassing counterfeit prevention, taint avoidance, and scrap management, including detection, critical issue, and supplier remediation of counterfeit or tampered components.

new_jobs.title: Technical Program Manager - Business Risk
new_jobs.description:
At Audible, we believe stories have the power to transform lives. It’s why we work with some of the world’s leading creators to produce and share audio storytelling with our millions of global listeners. We are dreamers and inventors who come from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences to empower and inspire each other. Imagine your future with us.  
  
ABOUT THIS ROLE  
As a Senior Technical Program Manager focused on Business Risk, you'll serve as the strategic risk advisor to one of Audible's business organizations, partnering with its senior leaders to understand and manage the risks they face across security, fraud, content piracy, data protection, brand, and operational domains. Audible's businesses depend on a broad network of external partners, vendors, platforms, and technology, and increasingly on AI-enabled operations. Each relationship and each system is a place where unauthorized access, fraud, data exposure, or operational failure can become financial loss or harm to the Audible brand.  
  
You will own Audible's business risk program for the organization you support end to end. You'll assess its business processes, vendor and partner relationships, and technology stack; drive remediation programs to completion with Audible InfoSec, Amazon Security, and business teams; run the recurring risk review and risk acceptance process; and own risk reporting to business and Audible leadership. Rather than building new programs, you'll use Audible's and Amazon's established risk management programs and paved path solutions, including security, fraud defense, piracy prevention, and data protection, and help the business adopt them in a way that fits how it works. Your understanding of the organization's strategy and roadmap will let you position risk management as an enabler, so the business can scale, enter new markets, and launch new initiatives safely.  
  
ABOUT YOU  
You thrive at the intersection of risk advisory and business enablement. You see risk not as a blocker but as a lens that helps a business grow safely and move faster. You are comfortable starting where the problem is not yet defined: you can take an open question such as "how exposed are we, and where?", frame the program, set its goals and success metrics, and drive it to delivery with limited guidance. You build trusted relationships with senior business leaders, translate technical risk into business language, and influence teams that do not report to you, including security, engineering, legal, and external partners. You make thoughtful trade-offs between short-term needs and long-term risk reduction, and you know how and when to escalate without damaging relationships. Your security background lets you speak credibly with security teams and understand the technical detail behind a risk. You write clear, concise narratives and are comfortable presenting risk decisions to Directors and VPs. You are a simplifier: you add process only where it earns its place, and you retire it when it no longer does.  
  
As a Senior Technical Program Manager - Business Risk, you will...  

* Serve as the primary business risk advisor to the senior leadership of the Audible business organization you support, building trusted relationships and helping leaders understand risks across security, fraud, content piracy, data protection, brand, and operational domains
* Own the business risk program for that organization end to end: define its scope, goals, and success metrics, and drive it from assessment through remediation with limited guidance
* Conduct risk assessments of the organization's business processes, platforms, technology stack, and vendor and partner relationships, and turn findings into prioritized, measurable remediation plans
* Drive governance and hardening programs for the external platforms, accounts, and third-party access the business depends on, in partnership with security and platform owners
* Assess risks in AI-enabled and automated business processes, including AI vendor solutions and the data that flows through them
* Run the recurring risk review and the risk acceptance and policy exception process for the organization, ensuring risk decisions are made at the right level, documented, and revisited
* Embed risk review into the organization's planning and launch processes, so new vendors, platforms, products, and markets are assessed before they go live rather than after an incident
* Partner with Audible InfoSec, Amazon Security, Fraud Defense, Anti-Piracy, Legal, Privacy, and Compliance to bring expert guidance and established paved path solutions to the business, and drive their adoption rather than building new programs
* Own risk reporting for the organization, developing risk metrics, dashboards, and executive narratives that give leadership clear visibility into risk posture and remediation progress
* Present risk information to Directors and VPs, laying out the options, the trade-offs between short-term needs and long-term risk reduction, and the decision required
* Negotiate priorities and resources across business, security, and engineering teams to deliver remediation on schedule, and escalate effectively when a path forward is blocked
* Proactively identify emerging risks from changes in the organization's business model, vendors, technology, and use of AI, and streamline or retire risk processes that no longer add value
* Contribute to Audible's broader business risk program, including the shared risk assessment framework, risk acceptance governance, and leadership reporting across business risk areas
* Mentor and develop others, and contribute to hiring for the business risk team

new_jobs.title: Senior Cybersecurity Risk Program Manager, Ops Supply Chain
new_jobs.description:
NVIDIA has been redefining computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s motivated by great technology and amazing people. Today, we’re harnessing the boundless possibilities of AI to build the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Pioneering what has never existed calls for insight, inventiveness, and the world’s leading talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be part of a diverse, encouraging environment where everyone is motivated to perform at their highest level. Join us and discover how you can build a lasting impact on the world.

  

NVIDIA is seeking a Senior Cybersecurity Risk Program Manager, Ops Supply Chain to join our Operations team in Santa Clara, CA. In this senior individual-contributor role, you will lead and develop NVIDIA’s supplier and supply chain cybersecurity risk program. You will continuously coordinate efforts to identify, assess, and mitigate cyber risk. Your work will protect NVIDIA intellectual property and critical invention data across our global network of suppliers, contract manufacturers, and logistics partners. If you’re forward-thinking, driven, and excited to protect one of the world’s most critical technology supply chains, this role is for you!

  

**What you’ll be doing:**

* Own and mature NVIDIA’s supply chain cybersecurity risk program, leading the assessment and mitigation of cyber risk across suppliers, contract manufacturers, and logistics and distribution partners.
* Build and improve supplier risk assessment frameworks, policies, and procedures aligned to NIST (CSF 2.0 and SP 800-161 Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management) and ISO (27001 and 28000) standards.
* Safeguard NVIDIA intellectual property and confidential technical data across the supplier ecosystem, defining controls for secure data exchange, need-to-know access, retention and destruction, and supervising supplier adherence to contractual security and confidentiality obligations.
* Support the supply chain CTPAT and counterfeit program, encompassing counterfeit prevention, taint avoidance, and scrap management, including detection, critical issue, and supplier remediation of counterfeit or tampered components.
* Develop and maintain business continuity, disaster recovery, and cyber incident management for supply chain events to ensure continuity of critical suppliers, components, and operations.
* Translate supplier cyber risks into operational requirements and executive-ready reporting, dashboards, and metrics that demonstrate program posture and progress.
Advise senior leadership on emerging supply chain threats and program strategy, and provide technical guidance and mentorship to cross-functional partners.  

  

**What we need to see:**

* 12+ years of demonstrated experience in cybersecurity, information security, supply chain risk, or third-party/vendor risk management, including governance, risk assessments, and compliance.
* Deep knowledge of cybersecurity supply chain frameworks and standards, including NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-161 (C-SCRM), and ISO 27001/28000.
* Proven experience leading supplier or third-party cybersecurity risk programs in a global, high-tech, or manufacturing environment.
* Hands-on experience with security incident management and business continuity or supply chain resilience planning.
* Experience protecting intellectual property and sensitive technical data in third-party environments, including data classification, access controls, and enforcement of confidentiality and security terms with suppliers.
* Familiarity with C-TPAT supply chain security requirements and counterfeit-part risk mitigation across hardware supply chains.
* Superb communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate supply chain cyber risks in business terms to technical and executive audiences.
* Proven ability to influence and drive alignment across multi-functional teams without direct authority.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in a technology, engineering, supply chain, or relevant scientific field required.  

  

**Ways to stand out from the crowd:**

* Certifications in one or more of the following areas: CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CISA, CTPRP, or CBCP.
* Proficiency with GRC and third-party risk management platforms such as OneTrust, RSA Archer, ServiceNow, or BitSight.
* Familiarity with electronics manufacurting, ISO 22301 business continuity management and C-SCRM maturity modeling within contra.
Proven ability to build and maintain metrics dashboards for tracking supply chain and third-party risk programs.  

  

Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you consider your future, explore what we can provide for you and your family at www.nvidiabenefits.com/ www.nvidiabenefits.com/

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary range for this position is 172,500 USD – 325,000 USD.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits .

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 24, 2026.
